smartHospital.title: Smart Hospital Solution
smartHospital.hero: By connecting to the hospital HIS system, Deshian provides a complete smart solution.
smartHospital.overview1: Starting from the top-level design of hospitals and smart wards, Deshian comprehensively promotes smart medical business and construction, committed to meeting the diverse needs of medical staff, patients, and hospital management.
smartHospital.overview2: This solution adopts advanced IoT, cloud computing, big data, and AI technologies to achieve interconnection and collaborative work among various hospital systems, improving hospital management efficiency, reducing operating costs, and enhancing medical service quality.
smartHospital.feature1Desc: Based on IP network, realizes HD audio and video intercom and information linkage between beds, nursing stations, and mobile terminals, improving medical response efficiency and service quality.
smartHospital.feature2Desc: Adopts two-wire bus design, integrating nursing station, ward bedside, bathroom and door light terminals to achieve full coverage calling and intercom in ward area, with simple wiring and stable reliability.
smartHospital.feature3Desc: Based on wireless network and cloud platform, integrates voice, video and data communication, realizes remote calling and intercom between center and terminals, with flexible deployment, suitable for various smart medical scenarios.
smartHospital.feature4Desc: Through wireless infusion caller, receiver and signal enhancer networking, combined with mobile management software, realizes remote monitoring and timely alarm of infusion status, improving infusion safety and management efficiency.
smartHospital.feature5Desc: Specially designed for clean area of operating room and external isolation area, realizes bidirectional HD audio and video calls and visits, ensuring sterile surgical environment while ensuring timely and smooth communication.
smartHospital.feature6Desc: Ensures time consistency across multiple terminals, integrates calibration/reminder/release functions, optimizes time management efficiency.
smartHospital.feature7Desc: Through intelligent queue management, realizes patient self-service number taking, number calling display, voice broadcast and other functions, optimizing visit process, reducing patient waiting time, and improving medical experience.
smartHospital.feature8Desc: Based on digital signage technology, realizes real-time release and management of various hospital information, including medical guidance, announcements, health education, improving information dissemination efficiency.
smartHospital.adv1Desc: Through digital medical intercom system and wireless call system, realize quick response, shorten medical staff arrival time, and improve emergency success rate.
smartHospital.adv2Desc: Wireless infusion call system monitors infusion status in real-time, timely alarms, effectively prevents abnormal infusion situations, and enhances patient safety.
smartHospital.adv3Desc: Queuing system realizes patient self-service number taking and intelligent diversion, reduces waiting time, improves visit efficiency, and enhances medical experience.
smartHospital.adv4Desc: Surgery/visit intercom system and two-wire medical intercom system ensure smooth doctor-patient communication and efficient medical team collaboration, improving medical service quality.
smartHospital.adv5Desc: Digital clock system ensures time synchronization in various hospital areas, combined with reminder function, optimizes medical process time node management, and improves work efficiency.
smartHospital.adv6Desc: Information display system realizes real-time release and management of various hospital information, data visualization platform provides decision support for hospital management.
smartHospital.contactDesc: For more information about Deshian Smart Hospital solution, please contact our sales consultant.

smartHealthcare.title: Smart Healthcare Solution
smartHealthcare.hero: Deshian Smart Healthcare System integrates AlOT technology to monitor health data and warn risks in real-time through smart devices, combined with home safety protection (fall alarm, environment control) and telemedicine, providing personalized health management solutions to help families, communities, and institutions achieve efficient and safe smart elderly care.
smartHealthcare.overview1: Deshian Smart Healthcare solution integrates elderly care intercom, care management, intelligent care, information release and other systems to build a comprehensive intelligent management platform for elderly care institutions, providing efficient, convenient, and intelligent information solutions.
smartHealthcare.overview2: This solution adopts advanced IoT, cloud computing, big data, and AI technologies to achieve interconnection and collaborative work among various systems of elderly care institutions, improving management efficiency, optimizing service processes, and enhancing the experience of the elderly and recovering individuals.
smartHealthcare.feature1Desc: Deshian Smart Aging Care System integrates elderly care intercom, care management, intelligent care, information release, personnel positioning and other functions, providing comprehensive intelligent management solutions for elderly care institutions. The system adopts advanced IoT, cloud computing and AI technologies to realize intelligent, refined and personalized elderly care services, improving service efficiency and elderly experience.
smartHealthcare.adv1Desc: Optimize elderly care service process, improve nursing staff work efficiency, and provide more timely services for the elderly.
smartHealthcare.adv2Desc: Provide comfortable living environment and intelligent care services, improving elderly satisfaction and happiness.
smartHealthcare.adv3Desc: Real-time monitoring and early warning system, timely discover and handle abnormal situations, ensuring elderly safety.
smartHealthcare.adv4Desc: Through data analysis and visualization, provide decision support for elderly care institution management, improving refined management level.
smartHealthcare.adv5Desc: Support integration with existing systems of elderly care institutions, realizing data sharing and business collaboration.
smartHealthcare.adv6Desc: Open system architecture, supports flexible configuration and expansion of functional modules, meeting personalized needs of different scenarios.
smartHealthcare.contactDesc: For more information about Deshian Smart Healthcare solution, please contact our sales consultant.
